description: This Java abstract class `BaseOpenmrsMetadata` provides a base implementation for metadata entities in the OpenMRS platform, including properties like name, description, creator, creation and modification dates, and retirement information. It serves as a superclass for various metadata types used within OpenMRS.

classes.name: BaseOpenmrsMetadata
classes.description: Abstract class serving as a base for metadata entities in OpenMRS, providing common properties such as name, description, creator, timestamps, and retirement indicators.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the metadata entity.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the name of the metadata entity.

methods.name: getDescription
methods.description: Returns the description of the metadata entity.

methods.name: setDescription
methods.description: Sets the description of the metadata entity.

methods.name: getCreator
methods.description: Returns the user who created this metadata.

methods.name: setCreator
methods.description: Sets the user who created this metadata.

methods.name: getDateCreated
methods.description: Returns the date when the metadata was created.

methods.name: setDateCreated
methods.description: Sets the creation date for the metadata.

methods.name: getChangedBy
methods.description: Returns the user who last changed this metadata (deprecated).

methods.name: setChangedBy
methods.description: Sets the user who last changed this metadata (deprecated).

methods.name: getDateChanged
methods.description: Returns the date when this metadata was last changed (deprecated).

methods.name: setDateChanged
methods.description: Sets the date when this metadata was last changed (deprecated).

methods.name: getRetired
